Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

IS: 8047 -1976 




Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

FORCEPS, EXTRACTION, DENTAL, 

UPPER MOLAR, CHILDREN 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for dental extraction forceps for use in 
dental surgery of children's upper molar. 

2. Material 

2.1 Arms — Shall be of stainless steel conforming to Designation 30Crl3 of IS: 6603-1972 
'Specification for stainless steel bars and flats \ 

2.2 Screws— Shall be of stainless steel conforming to Designation 20Cr13 of IS : 6603-1972. 

3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 FORCEPS, EXTRACTION, DENTAL, UPPER MOLAR, CHILDREN 

3.1 A deviation of ±2'5 percent shall be allowed on all dimensions. 

4. Mass — Shall be 100 ± 5 g. 

5. Other Requirements — The instruments shall satisfy the requirements given in 4 to 8 of 
IS : 6868-1972 ' General requirements for forceps, extraction, dental '. 

5.1 Performance Load— Shall be 35 ± 5 kg.
